questions.question: What should you do if you take a wrong turn during independent driving?
options: Carry on safely; it is not a fault by itself
Stop and reverse at the junction
Swerve across two lanes to make the exit
questions.explanation: Going off-route safely is not a fault, but unsafe swerving is.

questions.question: At a busy ring-road traffic light, when may you cross on green?
options: Only when there is space beyond the junction
Always, even if traffic blocks the exit
questions.explanation: Rule 176 says do not block the junction even on green.

questions.question: When leaving a 40 mph road for a 30 mph street, when must you slow?
options: Before you pass the 30 mph signs
Only if a camera is visible
questions.explanation: Rule 124 says speed limits apply as soon as you pass the sign.
